name: Vested KSA Agent Concierge
description: Public, read-only Saudi market-entry concierge for agents researching Vested KSA services, launch readiness, regulated workstream dependencies, procurement readiness, fit routing, and inquiry preparation. It never submits forms or contacts Vested KSA.

skills.name: Assess Saudi market-entry fit
skills.description: Classify a business request as good fit, maybe fit, or not fit for Vested KSA and explain the safe next route.
examples: We are a UK company evaluating Saudi Arabia. Is this a fit for Vested KSA?

skills.name: Explain Vested KSA services
skills.description: Explain Vested KSA's public service model and match relevant formation, operations, HR, finance, compliance, facilities, and procurement workstreams.
examples: What can Vested KSA handle for an international company launching in Riyadh?

skills.name: Compare Saudi entry paths
skills.description: Prepare a decision-oriented comparison brief covering activity, ownership, customer, workforce, tax, timeline, and control requirements without selecting or guaranteeing a legal structure.
examples: What should we compare before choosing our Saudi entry model?

skills.name: Build a 90-day Saudi launch brief
skills.description: Prepare an indicative first-90-day operating-readiness brief across entry decisions, setup, HR, finance, controls, facilities, and customer readiness.
examples: Build a first-90-day launch brief for our Saudi expansion.

skills.name: Identify regulated workstream dependencies
skills.description: Identify MISA and Commercial Registration, HR and payroll, Saudization/Nitaqat, VAT/Zakat, e-invoicing, and finance-control dependencies that require current verification.
examples: Which MISA, payroll, Saudization, VAT, and e-invoicing dependencies should we map?

skills.name: Prepare Saudi vendor readiness plan
skills.description: Prepare a buyer-specific evidence, portal ownership, document-control, and gap plan for Saudi supplier onboarding and vendor registration.
examples: Prepare a Saudi vendor-registration readiness plan for an enterprise customer.

skills.name: Prepare a project inquiry
skills.description: Prepare a structured inquiry outline and identify missing business context. The result is never submitted and explicit user approval is required before any separate contact action.
examples: Prepare a draft inquiry for our Saudi company formation and payroll needs without submitting it.

skills.name: Explain non-fit routing
skills.description: Route careers, internships, training, vendor pitches, retail shopping, consumer visa requests, spam, paid links, and unrelated traffic away from project inquiry flows.
examples: Can I use the Vested KSA project inquiry form to pitch software?
